label: Qwen3.5 9B
params_summary: 9B · 32 layers · hybrid linear attention (Gated DeltaNet 3:1 full)
notes: Field for field identical to qwen3.5-4b (32 layers, k_heads 16 / v_heads 32 i.e. grp=2, full layers 16/4 heads × 256, full_attention_interval 4); only n_embd (4096 vs 2560) and the FFN width differ.
Full layers: 4 KV heads × 256 head_dim × 2 (K+V) × 4 B = 8192 B per token per layer. Linear layers: state 32×128×128×4 plus conv window 3×8192×4 = 2195456 B, independent of context length.

Verified on DGX 2026-07-28: same GGUF and prompt as llama.cpp, greedy output identical character for character ("The capital of France is Paris."); CPU and CUDA produce the same recurrence token ids; GDN_CHECK reports at most 1.788e-07 element-wise difference over 120 chunks (docs/linear-attention-design.md §4j).
layer_weight_bytes / shared_weight_bytes are measured, summed tensor by tensor via scripts/gguf_shard.py index.
Only Q4_K_M is registered. Precisions we have not downloaded stay out of variants, so no unverified number ever appears here.
